This guide collects free and library-accessible material for students learning Stata in NYU Abu Dhabi methods courses. Begin with the three picks under Start here, then move to the sections on tutorials, do-files, video, and reporting as your projects need them. Software downloads and working habits are on the [Stata](../stata.html) page.

## Start here

- [Princeton University Online Stata Tutorial](https://www.princeton.edu/~otorres/Stata/) — Princeton University's online Stata tutorial, chosen here as a starting point for beginners.
- [UCLA Advanced Research Computing: Stata Learning Modules](https://stats.oarc.ucla.edu/stata/modules/) — Self-paced Stata modules from UCLA's research computing group, useful for practising one task at a time.
- [Resources for learning Stata from Stata Corp](https://www.stata.com/links/resources-for-learning-stata/) — The software maker's own list of ways to learn Stata, including training, books, and videos.

## Tutorials and course notes

- [NYUAD Stata Resources Page](https://guides.nyu.edu/stata) — NYU library research guide to Stata, with software access and learning material for the NYU community.
- [Stata Tutorial by Germán Rodríguez](https://grodri.github.io/stata/index) — Princeton's Germán Rodríguez covers the Stata interface, do-files, data management, tables, graphics, and programming.
- [Introduction to Stata, Social Science Computing Cooperative, UW-Madison](https://sscc.wisc.edu/sscc/pubs/intro_stata/intro_stata1.htm) — Introductory Stata notes from the University of Wisconsin-Madison's computing cooperative, starting with the first lesson.
- [Stata Highlights, Richard Williams, Notre Dame Sociology](https://academicweb.nd.edu/~rwilliam/stats/StataHighlights.html) — Excerpts from Richard Williams's graduate statistics course, with handouts and data files on regression, logistic regression, and more.
- [Introduction to Stata 15, LinkedIn Learning](https://www.linkedin.com/learning/introduction-to-stata-15) — Video course on Stata 15; NYU login required for free access.
- [The Stata Guide on Medium](https://medium.com/the-stata-guide) — Medium publication of Stata articles; some pieces sit behind Medium's paywall.
- [Using Stata's Frames feature to build an analytical dataset, Tim Plante](https://web.archive.org/web/20251006165902/https://blog.uvm.edu/tbplante/2021/11/15/using-statas-frames-feature-to-build-an-analytical-dataset/) — Blog post on combining several datasets in memory with Stata's frames to assemble one analysis dataset (archived copy).

## Writing good do-files

- [The Do's and Don'ts of a Do-file, Emmanuel Milet](https://web.archive.org/web/20240630034625/https://www.parisschoolofeconomics.eu/docs/yin-remi/do-file.pdf) — Paris School of Economics guide to writing do-files that others can read and rerun (archived copy).
- [Stata for Researchers: Do Files](https://web.archive.org/web/20210415222711/http://www.ssc.wisc.edu/sscc/pubs/sfr-do.htm) — University of Wisconsin-Madison computing cooperative notes on writing and running do-files (archived copy).
- [Stata Coding Guide, Julian Reif](https://julianreif.com/guide/#stata-coding-tips) — Julian Reif's guide to setting up a replication-ready Stata workflow, linked at its section of Stata coding tips.

## Video

- [Learning Stata, Steffen's Classroom playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLn6B3DUkuU_08whVgp3MeYLqltoFdBtum) — YouTube playlist of Stata lessons for beginners and for users brushing up.
- [Stata Corp YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@statacorp) — Official YouTube channel of the company that makes Stata.
- [Video tutorials on Stata](https://www.stata.com/links/video-tutorials/) — Stata Corp's list of video tutorials on Stata.
- [Introduction to Stata (UCLA workshop video)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SNQv3OQiggw) — Recorded workshop on basic Stata use, with slides and a do-file on UCLA's workshop page.
- [Sunday Stata Tips playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLj0WVD36ZMWoAH3xOdnfq4qqi2yJz4cRA) — YouTube playlist titled Sunday Stata Tips, a collection of Stata tips.

## Books and manuals

- [Bittmann, Felix. Stata: A Really Short Introduction (De Gruyter Oldenbourg, 2019)](https://doi.org/10.1515/9783110617160) — Short introductory book on Stata; the ebook can be accessed from the library website.
- [Econometric Analysis of Cross Section and Panel Data, downloadable materials](https://www.stata.com/texts/eacsap/) — Stata's page of datasets to download for Jeffrey Wooldridge's econometrics textbook.

## Tables and reports

- [estout: Making Regression Tables in Stata](https://repec.sowi.unibe.ch/stata/estout/estout.html) — Documentation for estout, a Stata package that turns estimation results into formatted regression tables.
- [dyndoc](https://www.stata.com/manuals/rptdyndoc.pdf) — Stata manual entry for the command that converts dynamic Markdown documents into HTML or Word files.
- [Reporting Reference Manual, Release 18](https://www.stata.com/bookstore/reporting-reference-manual/) — Stata Bookstore page for the Stata 18 manual covering the software's reporting tools.

## Cheatsheets and reference

- [Stata Cheatsheets (PDF)](https://www.stata.com/bookstore/statacheatsheets.pdf) — Stata's cheat sheets in a single PDF, inspired by RStudio's Cheatsheets.
- [Stata cheat sheets](https://www.stata.com/bookstore/stata-cheat-sheets/) — Stata Bookstore page where the individual cheat sheets can be downloaded.
- [Stata 18 Graphical User Interface (GUI) Overview](https://www.stata.com/features/overview/graphical-user-interface/) — Stata Corp's overview of the windows and menus in the Stata 18 interface.
- [Install and Uninstall Programs from Boston College Statistical Software Components (SSC)](https://www.stata.com/support/ssc-installation/) — Stata's instructions for adding and removing community-written packages from the SSC archive.
